independence_evidence: Published by Umbigo Edições, Lda, Lisbon; editorial statute describes it as 'an independent international platform' with public-funding partners (Ministry of Culture, Lisbon Municipality, Gulbenkian) rather than a media group (https://umbigo.space/en/info, https://umbigo.space/editorialstatute).
qualifies_reason: Independent Lisbon art magazine with a current print issue (#97) on sale in late 2026 and three issues a year.
what_it_is: Umbigo is a Portuguese contemporary art magazine, published since 2002, that builds each issue around a theme (issue 97 is 'Love') with essays, artist profiles, commissioned art projects and a curated exhibition section. Since issue 68 it has come out in separate Portuguese and English editions with two alternative artist covers per issue. It is for readers following contemporary art in Portugal and the Lusophone world.
